title: Witch in Misty Meadow
description: A witch in a flowing green robe and crown stands behind a stone altar table in a misty green meadow. She holds a glowing purple magical orb while various potions, candles, and mystical items rest on the table, surrounded by rising smoke, floating runes, and purple flowers under a soft dawn sky.
prompt: A witch wearing a green hooded robe and leafy crown stands at a stone altar in a lush misty meadow at dawn. She holds a glowing purple magical orb with runes floating around it. The altar is covered with potions, candles, and herbs. White smoke rises from the ground and table, purple flowers grow throughout the grass, wooden fences and distant hills visible in the soft foggy light.
